title: skills + docs: teach external.connector (D7) beside credentialsRef in the datasources skill rule and the two data-modeling guides — epic #27261 P2
body:
epic:#27261#1 · marchtian · session_017ihL2c5z3q4h8inrn5kwqV

type: Feature

## 维护者速读

- **做什么：** 数据源技能规则和两篇数据建模指南目前只教 `credentialsRef`；#27742 加了 `external.connector`（复用连接器授权），要把新写法教给 AI 作者和开发者。
- **为什么等 #27746：** 运行时读这个键之前，教它会让作者写出不生效的配置。
- **需要您做的：** 无。

## Task

- [ ] `skills/objectstack-data/rules/datasources.md`: an API-backed datasource borrows a declared connector instance's credential through `external.connector`; exclusive with `credentialsRef`; refused on built-in drivers and managed datasources.
- [ ] `content/docs/data-modeling/virtual-objects.mdx` and `content/docs/data-modeling/external-datasources.mdx`: the same, with one example (an OData datasource naming a connector instance).
- [ ] A skills change releases `@objectstack/skills` (route 1 changeset).

`Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`. Touches `skills/**`: owes an independent full Fable review before landing.
